rationale: MVP package C04 of the agent fleet controller wedge selected in docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/REPORT.md; dependent on earlier packages where stated.

work.title: C04 — Learned model/effort policy from verifiable outcomes
work.description: Per task category, compute success and cost statistics from the ledger; apply an explicit escalate-fast (after a failure) / downgrade-slow (after statistically meaningful evidence) rule; show recommendations with the evidence behind them; `--enforce` only after ≥N observations per category; log regret versus the static assignment. Later: contextual bandit over category, provider availability and prior failures.
work.acceptance_criteria: On ≥50 ledger tasks, quality-adjusted throughput (verified completions per subscription/quota unit) of the learned policy beats the operator's static assignment, computed from the same ledger; recommendations are explainable from recorded evidence; tests on synthetic ledgers. Stop rule: no measurable improvement → keep C01–C03 as a utility and record the negative result.
